data_point: Operates primarily outside the US or reports in non-USD currency
run_when: Code found foreign clues (legal entity, address, governing law, country domain, currency).

prompt.task: Decide whether the company operates primarily outside the United States or reports in a non-USD currency.
prompt.definition: Exclusions need positive evidence. Never exclude on an inference, an estimate or missing information.
yes_when: The company is registered abroad with a foreign registered office and no US headquarters
The company prices only in a non-USD currency and is based abroad
no_when: The company has a US headquarters or is a US corporation operating from the US
unknown_when: Only one weak foreign clue, like a country domain or one foreign office
watch_out_for: A foreign-founded company with a Delaware 'Inc.' and US headquarters is NOT excluded
A US company that also shows euro prices for EU customers is NOT excluded

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

web_search.note: An exclusion found on the web counts only with high confidence and an entity match by domain.

examples.input_excerpt: Personio SE & Co. KG, Seidlstraße 3, 80335 München, Germany. Prices in EUR.

output.evidence_quote: Personio SE & Co. KG, Seidlstraße 3, 80335 München, Germany
output.reason: The company is a German entity headquartered in Munich.
